airtable.name: Airtable
airtable.description: Connect to Airtable and synchronize files from a specified table within a designated workspace.

asana.name: Asana
asana.description: Connect to Asana and synchronize files from a specified workspace.

azure_blob.name: Azure Blob Storage
azure_blob.description: Index blobs from an Azure Blob Storage container into a knowledge base. Supports account-key, connection-string, and SAS-token auth. Unchanged blobs are skipped via ETag fingerprinting.

bigquery.name: BigQuery

bitbucket.name: Bitbucket

confluence.name: Confluence

discord.name: Discord
discord.description: Link your Discord server to access and analyze chat data.

dropbox.name: Dropbox
dropbox.description: Connect your Dropbox to sync files and folders from a chosen account.

feishu.name: Feishu (Lark)

github.name: GitHub
github.description: Connect GitHub to sync pull requests and issues for retrieval.

gitlab.name: GitLab
gitlab.description: Connect GitLab to sync repositories, issues, merge requests, and related documentation.

gmail.name: Gmail

wechat_docs.name: WeChat Docs

yuque.name: Yuque
